summary: Converts two floats from a caller-supplied array (a2[0] and a2[2]) into signed 16-bit fixed-point shorts stored at this[20] (offset 0x28) and this[21] (offset 0x2A). Each float is two-sided range checked against 63.998047; in-range values are multiplied by 512.0 and truncated, out-of-range values clamp to 0x7FFF or -32767. The middle element a2[1] is not read.

operations.description: Upper-range check on a2[0]: if *a2 > 63.998047 take the high-clamp branch (0x7FFF).
Lower-range check on a2[0]: if *a2 < -63.998047 take the low-clamp branch (-32767).
In-range path for a2[0]: v6 = *a2 * 512.0, then truncate to a short via (int) cast.
Write the encoded/clamped short for a2[0] into this[20] at offset 0x28 (written unconditionally).
Upper-range check on a2[2]: if a2[2] > 63.998047 take the high-clamp branch (0x7FFF).
Lower-range check on a2[2]: if a2[2] < -63.998047 take the low-clamp branch (-32767).
In-range path for a2[2]: v7 = a2[2] * 512.0, then truncate to a short via (int) cast.
Write the encoded/clamped short for a2[2] into this[21] at offset 0x2A (written unconditionally).
Return the second encoded short value as the function result.

unresolved: a2[1] is not processed; only a2[0] and a2[2] are converted.
Identity and layout of the destination object are unknown (owner UNKNOWN); offsets 0x28 and 0x2A hold 16-bit shorts.
The three float globals (flt_5ACCB4, flt_5ACCB8, flt_5ACCBC) back the scale/clamp constants, but their values are inlined as literals in the raw source.
Callers VehicleOrientationFromEulerAngles (0x004B2DD0), sub_4B32A0 (0x004B32A0) and SetupCarLightingAndRender (0x004C71C0) all write the same fields; semantic reuse is caller-dependent.
